verification.precondition: No process holds Survey runtime objects and only explicit CLI inputs, run state, and the external key registry are shared.
verification.stimulus: Initialize in one Node process, execute next in a second process, and repeat next in a third process.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Independent processes reconstruct the same identity and emit a byte-identical pending view while the third process performs no write.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: independent surveyctl processes resume one run and reissue the exact pending view
verification.forbiddenMutation: Cold resume must not rely on imported warm objects, regenerate identity, or alter session bytes on repeated next.

behavior: independent surveyctl processes resume one run and reissue the exact pending view
